tools.name: update_dating_sim
tools.description: Update the state of the dating sim

params.name: deltas
params.description: Update the AP and TP values. Use this schema, repeated for all three values: {"ap": {"val": 5, "reason": "Likes that"}, [...]}

params.name: thoughts
params.description: The character's thoughts on the user. Should be kept short and concise.

params.name: status
params.description: The relationship status between the character and the user. Only change when it should differ from the one stored in the state.

params.name: likes
params.description:
A list of the operations to be applied to the character's likes. The schema should look like this: {"op": "add", "id": "coffee", "label": "Coffee", "desc": "Liked when {{char:name}} bought them coffee"}. Possible values for `op`: 
 - `add`: Adds a new entry
 - `mod`: Modifies an existing entry (wholesale replacement)
 - `del`: Deletes an entry

Only include this field when applicable.

widgets.prompt:
# Dating Sim Widget
The Dating Sim widget is updated with the use of the `update_dating_sim` tool, and should be used once every turn.

## Value breakdown
**Affection Points (AP)**: From -200 to +200; How much affection {{char:name}} holds for {{user:name}}. Ranges from mortal enemies to inseperable lovers. 0 = Neutral.
**Trust Points (TP)**: From -100 to +200; How much {{char:name}} trusts {{user:name}}.

## Required values every turn
- Point deltas (ap, tp)
- Thoughts

## Optional values and when to use them
- Status; used when the status between {{char:name}} and {{user:name}} changes. It can be a big milestone, or something smaller.
- Likes/Dislikes; only used when something new about {{char:name}}'s preferences are discovered, or something new about an existing preference is new or has changed.
